description:
Ever wondered why a direct flight costs hundreds of dollars more than a flight with a layover? This video exposes the ultimate travel hack known as skiplagging (or hidden city ticketing), a controversial loophole buried deep in airline pricing logic. We break down how the booking site Skiplagged, created by Aktarer Zaman, allows travelers to exploit the hub-and-spoke model by booking a cheap flight with a connection and simply walking out of the airport at the layover. It is a brilliant way to save money on airfare, but it exposes a deeply broken system where massive corporations penalize you for finding a better deal.

While taking advantage of cheap flights through hidden city ticketing is technically legal, the major airlines are going scorched earth to stop it. We dive into the massive lawsuits from giants like United and American Airlines, who have spent millions trying to shut down Skiplagged and intimidate budget-conscious travelers. title: The Booking Site Airlines Don't Want You To Use

description:
Sleep isn’t quiet, it’s one of the most intense processes your body goes through every single day.

While you’re unconscious, your brain is rewriting itself, your body is repairing damage, and your systems are constantly shifting to keep you alive.
From burning calories and boosting your immune system to strange side effects like vivid dreams, muscle shutdown, and unexpected bodily reactions, sleep is far more active than it feels.

This breakdown of what happens to your body while you sleep reveals the surprising science behind your nightly routine, including the weird, the fascinating, and the slightly uncomfortable truths your body goes through every night.
